name: tree-sitter-nurt
description: Tree-sitter grammars for Nurt program text.
author: Danaco Holding Group Sp. z o.o. <support@danaco-group.pl>

scripts.generate: tree-sitter generate && cd variant-b && tree-sitter generate && cd ../variant-c && tree-sitter generate
scripts.test: tree-sitter test && cd variant-b && tree-sitter test && cd ../variant-c && tree-sitter test && cd .. && node scripts/generate-corpus.js --check
scripts.corpus: node scripts/generate-corpus.js && tree-sitter test --update && cd variant-b && tree-sitter test --update && cd ../variant-c && tree-sitter test --update
